name: reelbolt
description: Connect Claude Code to ReelBolt: the platform assistant's own tools over MCP (projects, files, agents, workflow authoring and execution), plus skills for inspecting a project's runs and authoring workflows. You sign in through your browser; there is no token to paste.

server_url.title: ReelBolt MCP server URL
server_url.description: The address of your ReelBolt MCP endpoint, ending in /mcp. For ReelBolt Cloud use https://reelbolt.ai/mcp; a self-hosted installation uses its own domain plus /mcp. Claude Code connects here, then opens your browser to sign you in and ask for your approval, so there is no token to create or paste.
